snippet.title: Lunar Ascendant - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Artemis, humanity’s first colony on the Moon - and the stage for a new kind of political simulation RPG.

In Lunar Ascendant, you are David De Silva, the first mayor of Artemis, appointed to lead a fractured lunar city caught between Earth’s competing interests and the fragile hope of independence.

Make impossible decisions. Manage limited resources. Balance the power of factions. And face the consequences of every choice.

🗳 Key Features:
• Narrative-driven political simulator
• Turn-based decision-making
• Faction diplomacy and city management
• Moral dilemmas with long-term impact
• Atmospheric sci-fi worldbuilding
Can you govern the future, or will the Moon fall into chaos?

- Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2547090/Lunar_Ascendant/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=Trailer&utm_medium=DartsGames
